stories.title: Fiona the hippo dies after swallowing a visitor's hat
stories.summary: The Cincinnati Zoo hippo who won over the internet as a premature calf in 2017 died at nine, days after a child's knit hat was flung into her habitat. Timelines filled with old Fiona videos.

stories.title: The Colts owner's sideline note-taking becomes a meme
stories.summary: Cameras caught Carlie Irsay-Gordon scribbling notes with a puzzled look during the Colts' loss to the Texans, and fans turned it into a template.
